name: Mighty Auto Parts
old_description: Since 1963, Mighty has been the gold standard of parts distribution exclusively to the automotive service professional. Our trademark combination of high quality products, inventory management, superior personal service, and competitive pricing set us apart as the premier stocking supplier. In today's world when so-called customer service, support teams, and suppliers are often literally separated by oceans, it's good to know Mighty parts, service, technical support and business expertise you need are available from your local Mighty Representative.
about:
Mighty Auto Parts operates a wholesale distribution franchise at 1180 Center Point Drive in Henderson, Nevada. The corporate brand was founded in 1963 and is now part of Grupo Gonher, headquartered in Peachtree Corners, Georgia. The Henderson location is managed by designated manager Scott Worrall and serves the local market with bilingual English and Spanish support.

The company distributes automotive replacement parts sourced from original-equipment manufacturers, carrying product lines that include brakes, filters, batteries, belts and tensioners, chemicals, hardware and fasteners, motor oil and lubricants, shop supplies, tire-service items, tools and equipment, wipers, and personal protection equipment. Beyond parts supply, the franchise provides value-added services such as professional inventory management, obsolescence protection, business consulting, customized technician training, an online catalog (MIC), a Rapid Rewards loyalty program, shop-management software, and marketing support.

Customers are exclusively professional automotive service providers — independent repair shops, dealership service departments, and fleet maintenance operations — in the Henderson area. The business model is strictly B2B wholesale; no retail or consumer sales are conducted at this location.

Mighty positions its differentiation on local accessibility and service depth: a dedicated representative is available on-site rather than through offshore call centers, and the combination of inventory management, technical support, and business expertise is intended to protect shop profitability against parts obsolescence and supply-chain gaps.
built_on: Local representative on-site, not offshore support
Professional inventory management with obsolescence protection
Value-added training, business tools, and marketing support
Exclusive focus on professional technicians, not retail
